metadata.title: The moduli space of quasimorphisms on subshifts and its pressure geometry
metadata.abstract: We introduce a metric geometry on the space of positive, linearly growing quasimorphisms on a mixing subshift of finite type. Two such quasimorphisms are identified when their homogenizations agree up to multiplicative scaling. The resulting moduli space carries a natural symmetrised Thurston-type metric, defined from the extremal ratios of their periodic orbit lengths. We prove that this is a genuine metric and determine several global features of the resulting space: it is unbounded, separable, incomplete, and has geodesics that are canonically generated by thermodynamic pressure functions. We then describe the endpoints of these geodesics and develop a boundary theory for our moduli space. We apply this theory to metric structures on right-angled Artin and Coxeter groups. In particular we construct isometric embeddings of geometric moduli spaces into our quasimorphism moduli spaces. As a consequence, Manhattan curves for metrics on these groups are $C^1$, with equality cases characterised by rough similarity of the underlying metrics. This provides insights into Manhattan curves in settings where neither classical thermodynamic formalism for Hölder potentials nor Patterson-Sullivan theory apply. The same construction recovers the corresponding results for hyperbolic groups and places these examples within a common dynamical-geometric framework.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 拟态射模空间的压力几何
analysis.workSummary: 对混合有限型子移位上的正线性增长拟态射，按齐次化比例取商并用周期轨长度比定义对称 Thurston 型度量，研究压力生成的测地线、边界及 RAAG、Coxeter 群应用。
analysis.breakthrough: 在经典 Hölder 势与 Patterson–Sullivan 方法不足的设置中得到 C¹ Manhattan 曲线及粗相似等号刻画。
analysis.limitations: 模空间可分但不完备；相关测地线和边界是这一商空间的结构，不是全部群度量的统一完备化。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第12页明确声明本项目未使用 AI 辅助写作或数学陈述、证明，未发现正面协作披露。
